rationale: Price at $11.10 is holding above both the session VWAP ($10.84) and the 5m 9-EMA ($11.00), so the recovery thesis that justified the long remains intact with no thesis violation. The risk-on backdrop (SPY +0.55%, VIXY -1.00%) still supports continuation, while invalidation ($10.83) and take-profit ($11.50) sit at reasonable ATR-scaled distances (~2.7x and ~4x ATR).
